name: Xeph
author: Bruce R. Cordell
sourceDistinctions: Racial Burst is a 3-round competence bonus. The swift psionic power of the same name is a separate rule.
The racial ability specifies no activation action, so the core supernatural default applies.
No 2006 erratum changes Xeph or racial Burst. Soulknife uses the corrected first-level skill point rate of (4 + Int modifier) × 4.
portraitForm: Rovan Threadglass, an original Xeph example
